one_liner: Ranks every number by how many times it was drawn in all earlier draws of the current era.
registry_status_reason: Revision 3 (MHUP-1 design v0.1r5 section 2; owner decisions MHUP-Q10 and MHUP-R, ratified 3 November 2026): the multi-game function takes the view data kind, never a run mode, so E_1 runs in Mode H and the weekly session under the shared target and mode gates; counting, ranking and tie order are unchanged. Revision 2 is archived in archive/methods/E_001/r2/. effective_date is the date this entry was prepared and frozen for review in its package, not an installation or release date (owner decision, 4 November 2026, EX_142 C01): the release date comes only from the create-only release record (design 4.3).
short_explanation: E_1 counts how often each number appeared in every draw before the target draw, within the current era of the game, and ranks the numbers from most to least often drawn. Numbers with equal counts are put in a fixed order by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not the order they came out in or the dates. It is a baseline: if the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
